synth.notes:
Two-axis mirror puzzle on a 3x3 block grid (x=row): H wall row band + V wall column; A5 cycles H -> V -> pieces (by min block) -> H.
A1/A2 move selection one block up/down, A3/A4 left/right; H ignores A3/A4, V ignores A1/A2; pieces stay in bounds and off other pieces.
Pieces mirror across V as visible gray reflections and across H / both axes as invisible -1 occluders; a piece with any block on the H row gets an invisible V-mirror (the step-268 repair; removing it fails only step 268).
Frame is re-rendered from layer stacks (piece > visible refl > invisible refl > solid target > V > H; selected wall dots solid 0) and re-extracted: wall/player = 4-conn comps of own colour plus all 0 dots, ranked by bbox; reflection ranks also count invisible comps; targets merged when the bbox coord gap is <=4.
Player gone vs x under A1 = renaming from 0-dot ranks, not a target interaction. Unconfirmed: whether pieces block each other (never observed). Program is stateless.
